title: Sony Smartwatch 3 not working as a collector
symptom: Sony Smartwatch 3 (SW3) with updated firmware (M1D64T, unrooted) does not collect values from a Blucon when used as a collector with xDrip+ on an Elephone P8000. The watch shows as connected to the Blucon in xDrip+ but does not receive values, and the phone service stops because of the watch.
fix: Downgrading to xDrip+ version 2018-03-12 resolved the issue; the SW3 connected to the Blucon and worked as a collector.
evidence_quote: Strange, I tried xDrip+ version 2018-03-12, and this time the SSW3 connected to the Blucon and worked as a collector. So staying at the moment with 2018-03-12 I can close the issue.
